traffic_projections.methodology: Volume estimates from keyword tools and SERP analysis. Achievable rank = top 5 position within 6-12 months for a niche e-commerce site with existing domain authority and relevant content. CTR assumptions: position 1 = 28%, position 2-3 = 15%, position 4-5 = 8%.

path_to_100k.note: The 13-post cluster architecture above targets roughly 25,000-30,000 monthly searches in the direct cluster. Reaching 100,000 monthly visitors requires expanding this cluster to 3 more cluster groups (state-specific pages, specific game title guides, home bar and gaming room setup content) plus building domain authority through the existing blog schedule. The cluster plan provides the structural foundation; the 100k target requires 6-12 more months of content and authority building.
